metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Claims Center" "C4 model of the insurance claims platform" {
    model {
        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "Reports claims and tracks their progress"
        adjuster = person "Adjuster" "Processes assigned claims"

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform" {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app"
            intake = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims"
            triage = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims"
            assessment = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts"
            payout = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements"
            fraud = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Flags suspicious claims"
            document = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports"
            notification = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders"
            assignment = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters"
            workbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims"
            policyVerification = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy"
            reinsurance = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners"
            batch = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts"
            claimsDb = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records"
            policyDb = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records"
            auditDb = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence"
        }

        mobileApp = softwareSystem "Mobile App" "The insurer's mobile app"
        bureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "Operated by a different organization"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "Operated by a different organization"

        policyholder -> webPortal "Reports claims and tracks progress"
        policyholder -> mobileApp "Reports claims and tracks progress"
        mobileApp -> mobileAppBackend "Uses"
        adjuster -> workbench "Processes assigned claims"

        webPortal -> intake "Uses"
        webPortal -> assessment "Uses"
        webPortal -> payout "Uses"
        webPortal -> document "Uses"
        webPortal -> notification "Uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> intake "Uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessment "Uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> payout "Uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> document "Uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> notification "Uses"

        intake -> triage "Hands accepted claims"
        intake -> fraud "Sends each incoming claim for screening"
        triage -> assessment "Routes claims"
        assessment -> payout "Requests settlements"

        fraud -> bureau "Consults"
        policyVerification -> policyDb "Checks the cover"
        assignment -> workbench "Routes the claim"
        payout -> clearingHouse "Executes settlements through"

        document -> documentStore "Reads"
        batch -> claimsDb "Reads and writes"
        batch -> policyDb "Reads and writes"
        notification -> policyholder "Reports claim status changes"
    }
    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "SystemContext" "System context diagram for the Claims Center" {
            include *
        }
        container claimsCenter "Container" "Container diagram for the Claims Center" {
            include *
        }
    }
}
